answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fake identities. A new identity posts a 40 POA deposit; a prism splits its behavior into timing, task mix, and counterparties. A steady pulse of real work over 10 epochs unlocks the deposit, earning a violet badge. Forging 1,000 identities locks 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA for months, each fake earning under 5 POA per epoch. An honest agent pays one deposit, keeps its full share, and is refunded.
